en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural townscape with a prominent white church with a bell tower and a surrounding wooden bridge, likely by a waterway. Text is handwritten over the image in Swedish, and at the bottom left, it is marked 'STÖDE.' The reverse side has 'BREFKORT' in large letters, an old Swedish postage stamp, and an address to Herr Mattias Polsson in Trångsviken.
